env-app-context.report: The topbar's context has no class of its own in 1.0: it sits in Sidebar.Header after the SidebarTrigger, or in AppShell.Header's start; style your own element there.

env-app-actions.report: The topbar's actions have no class of their own in 1.0: they sit in AppShell.Header's end; style your own element there.

env-app-topbar-context.report: The split topbar is gone: the context sits in Sidebar.Header, which lines up with AppShell.Header.

env-app-topbar-page.report: The split topbar is gone: the title and actions are AppShell.Header's children and end.

env-app-loading-bar.report: The page progress bar is AppShell.Root's loading; it has no public class.

env-app-navigation-placeholder.report: AppShellSkeleton is gone: NavList.Skeleton stands in for the navigation, and its placeholders have no public class.

env-app-shell-skeleton.report: AppShellSkeleton is gone: wrap the frame's parts in a LoadingState, whose class is env-loading-state.

env-app-sidebar-backdrop.report: Below the breakpoint the sidebar is a Drawer, with the Drawer's own backdrop.

env-app-toggle-icon.report: SidebarTrigger is an IconButton; its icon has no public class.

env-app-shell.report: AppShell.Root no longer marks the sidebar's state: select .env-sidebar[data-state='collapsed'], [data-rail] while it shows icons only and [data-peek] while it shows over the content; below the breakpoint the root has data-mobile and the sidebar is a drawer; the topbar's layout is data-header-span.
